balance.conclusion: Farm transitions and paid player trade worked. Default100 AI wood search needed a targeted recovery fix; its full-match effect is not measured. Neither automated run reached the600-second AI trade gate. These samples do not establish a12-15-minute average,20+ minute depletion, or natural late-game AI trade. No broader balance tuning inferred. Prior3-vs4-worker calculations remain in docs/balance_2026-10-26.md.

limitations: No physical phone, OS-installed PWA lifecycle or device thermal/performance measurements. Browser mobile viewport and native ScreenTouch tests only.
The12-15-minute average and20+ minute resource-exhaustion targets remain unverified; one natural AI result and one partial run are not a distribution.
AI wood fix prevents idle workers falling back to food when visible wood is missing. It does not forcibly redirect a fully employed food workforce restored from an old save.
Controlled route tests and public multiplayer combat are functional checks, not full-match duration evidence.
